title: 第八章 后天五重
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
虽然蛇类妖兽不以力量见长，但是后天四重初期的五彩大蟒尾巴甩出来的力量绝对超过一千斤，被结结实实的抽中了，连骨头都会被抽断。
“嘭！”叶希文的双掌迎了上去，狠狠撞到了一起，又是金铁交鸣的声音。
叶希文顿时大喝一声，牢牢的抓住了那条抽过来的尾巴，手臂上的青筋顿时暴起，运起全身的力量，将五彩大蟒给在半空中甩了起来。
“呼呼！”一百多斤的五彩大蟒被叶希文在半空中狠狠甩了起来，发出呼呼的破空声。
“轰！”一声巨响，那条五彩大蟒被叶希文给直接抽到了峭壁上。
那条五彩大蟒被叶希文这用力一抽，直接深深陷入了峭壁之中，粗长的身体中都渗出了血丝了，很显然这一抽力度不小，五彩大蟒挣扎着想逃出，但是叶希文哪里会让这条大蟒如意，立刻又舞了起来。
“轰！”
“轰！”
“轰！”
很快，这条五彩大蟒就被叶希文给生生摔死了。
叶希文都顾不上休息，挖出这条五彩大蟒的妖核之后就立刻将地心果给挖了出来。
叶希文很快就离开了这个地方，因为这里的血腥很快就会引来山上的其他妖兽，到时候不免又是一阵麻烦，虽然说，这里是山脉的外面地区，不会有太强大的妖兽，但是也是一桩麻烦的事情，而且万一有那一只不按常理出牌的强大的妖兽跑出来，那他哭都没地方哭去。
这山上的妖兽太多了，他也不能不防，一元宗之所以坐落在这样的一座山上，就是为了震慑住山中的诸多妖兽，以避免妖兽下山扰民。
叶希文很快就回到了一元宗之中，还是和他几天前离开的时候差不多，没什么变化，叶希文径直来到了一元宗的功德殿，一元宗中专门负责将宗内的弟子贡献出来的物品兑换成宗门积分的。
叶希文大步走了进去，来到兑换积分的的管事面前，这些管事都是学院中的一些实权人物，并不是长老，但是却掌握着一些实权，虽然实力不算太高，一般弟子都是惹不起的。
这个年轻管事叫王石，以前也是一元宗的弟子，为人比较刻薄，又喜欢巴结权势人物，一般的弟子都不喜欢他
王石有些倨傲的说道：“你也要换取积分么？”
“不是！”叶希文摇摇头，拿出了那个箭猪兽和五彩大蟒的妖核。“我希望将这两个妖核换成晶石！”
王石只是很淡然的将两颗妖核收下，然后说道：“后天五重的妖核可以换成下品灵石二十块，两个可以换成下品灵石四十块！”
“恩！”叶希文表示赞同，虽然说妖核之间的品质也都各有差距，如果私下里去卖的话，可能会有多一块两块的，不过却远没有直接向功德殿换取要方便的多了。

接过了灵石之后叶希文就转身离去，有了四十块下品灵石和地心果，完全可以将奔雷九手直接推演到第九响的程度，到那个时候，这一项武技就圆满了。
叶希文离开了功德殿，回到了自己的小院子中，时间越来越紧迫了，他必须要尽快的提升自己的实力。
叶希文盘坐在床铺上上，取出地心果，吞服了下去，地心果吞入之后，地心果很快就化成了一道热流化入了叶希文的身体中。
一道热流从丹田升起，全身真气顿时疯狂运转起来，叶希文的脸也开始变的通红
伴随着叶希文体内真气的疯狂运转，原本稳固的境界开始不断出现松动。
叶希文全力调动体内的真气，炼化起这些能量，每炼化一份，叶希文体内的真气就壮大一份，还有更多的能量在叶希文的引导下开始淬炼起身体来。
无数的能量将叶希文全身的细胞都撕裂再重组，重组再撕裂，叶希文的脸上露出一种痛苦和享受纠结在一起的感觉，无数细胞被撕裂的时候，只觉得全世界在崩塌，叶希文的身上噼里啪啦的作响，仿佛是一阵阵鞭炮被放响的声音，这是叶希文的肉身在经历改造。
叶希文立刻下了床铺，进入了小院子中，大喝一声，开始打起了奔雷手的套路，脑海中一道人影在飞速演练着奔雷手的精髓，两颗妖核换来的四十块灵石中的灵气纷纷奔涌而出，涌入叶希文的身体之中。

content_en:
Although snake monsters are not known for their strength, the force of the tail of the colorful python in the early stage of the acquired fourth level is definitely more than a thousand kilograms. It was hit so hard that even the bones would be broken.
"Bang!" Ye Xiwen's palms came up and hit each other hard, and there was another sound of gold and iron clashing.
Ye Xiwen immediately shouted loudly and firmly grasped the pulled tail. The veins on his arms suddenly popped out. He used all his strength to throw the colorful python up in the air.
"Huhu!" The colorful python, which weighed more than 100 kilograms, was violently thrown up in mid-air by Ye Xiwen, making a whirring sound.
"Boom!" With a loud noise, Ye Xiwen whipped the colorful python directly onto the cliff.
The colorful python was whipped hard by Ye Xiwen, and it fell deeply into the cliff. Blood oozed from its long and thick body. It was obvious that the force of the whip was not small. The colorful python struggled to escape, but Ye Xiwen did not let the python get what it wanted, and it immediately started dancing again.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
Soon, the colorful python was thrown to death by Ye Xiwen.
Ye Xiwen didn't even bother to rest. After digging out the demon core of the colorful python, he immediately dug out the core fruit.
Ye Xiwen left this place quickly, because the blood here would soon attract other monsters on the mountain, which would inevitably cause another wave of trouble. Although this was an area outside the mountains, there would not be too powerful monsters, but it was still a troublesome thing, and if a powerful monster came out that did not follow common sense, he would have no place to cry.
There were too many monsters on this mountain, and he had to guard against them. The reason why Yiyuan Sect was located on such a mountain was to deter the many monsters in the mountain, so as to prevent the monsters from coming down the mountain to disturb the people.
Ye Xiwen quickly returned to the Yiyuan Sect. It was almost the same as when he left a few days ago. There was no change. Ye Xiwen went straight to the Merit Hall of the Yiyuan Sect. The Yiyuan Sect was responsible for exchanging the items contributed by the disciples of the sect into sect points.
Ye Xiwen strode in and came to the stewards who were redeeming points. These stewards were all powerful figures in the college. They were not elders, but they held some real power. Although their strength was not too high, ordinary disciples could not afford to offend them.
This young steward is called Wang Shi. He used to be a disciple of the Yiyuan Sect. He was quite mean and liked to curry favor with powerful people. Most disciples didn’t like him.
Wang Shi said a little arrogantly: "Do you also want to exchange points?"
"No!" Ye Xiwen shook his head and took out the demon core of the porcupine beast and the colorful python. "I hope to replace these two demon cores with crystal stones!"
Wang Shi just accepted the two demon cores very calmly, and then said: "The acquired fifth level demon core can be exchanged for twenty pieces of low-grade spiritual stones, and the two can be exchanged for forty yuan of low-grade spiritual stones!"
"Yes!" Ye Xiwen agreed. Although the quality of the demon cores also differs, if you sell them privately, you may get an extra piece or two, but it is far less convenient than directly exchanging them with the Hall of Merit.
After taking the spirit stones, Ye Xiwen turned around and left. With forty low-grade spirit stones and earth core fruits, he could directly perform the Nine Hands of Thunder to the ninth ring. At that time, this martial skill would be complete.
Ye Xiwen left the Hall of Merit and returned to his small courtyard. Time was getting tighter and he had to improve his strength as soon as possible.
Ye Xiwen sat cross-legged on the bed, took out the earth core fruit, and swallowed it. After swallowing the earth core fruit, the earth core fruit quickly turned into a stream of heat and entered Ye Xiwen's body.
A stream of heat rose from Dantian, and the whole body's energy suddenly began to circulate crazily, and Ye Xiwen's face began to turn red.
With the crazy movement of the true energy in Ye Xiwen's body, the originally stableThe solid realm begins to loosen.
Ye Xiwen mobilized the true energy in his body with all his strength to refine the energy. With each portion refined, the true energy in Ye Xiwen's body grew stronger, and more energy began to temper the body under Ye Xiwen's guidance.
Countless energy tore and reorganized all the cells in Ye Xiwen's body, reorganized and torn apart again. Ye Xiwen's face showed a feeling of pain and enjoyment intertwined. When countless cells were torn apart, he felt that the whole world was collapsing. Ye Xiwen's body crackled like bursts of firecrackers being set off. This was Ye Xiwen's physical body undergoing transformation.
Ye Xiwen immediately got off the bed, entered the small courtyard, shouted loudly, and began to perform the Thunder Hand's routine. A figure in his mind was rapidly practicing the essence of the Thunder Hand. The spiritual energy from the forty spiritual stones exchanged for the two demon cores rushed out and poured into Ye Xiwen's body.
